eventDetail.scope: AsiaEdu is the premier forum for the presentation of new advances and research results in the fields of Education Technology. The conference will bring together leading academic scientists, researchers and scholars in the domain of interest from around the world. Topics of interest for submission include, but are not limited to: Artificial Intelligence in Education, Inclusive Learning Environments and Emerging Technologies in Learning.
